title: Audit and update CI workflow tier:docs selector
objective: Confirm GitHub Actions workflows route the tier:docs label / pytest -m docs selector to the right job; correct or add jobs as needed.

plan_assets.asset_description: Risk: existing GitHub Actions selector may rely on integration marker — audit before deleting marker references

scope: Ensure tier:docs label / -m docs selector hits the correct job
No changes outside CI workflow files
implementation_steps: Update or add a job running pytest -m docs
Validate via gh workflow run or local act dry-run
deliverables: CI workflow updated to invoke pytest -m docs
acceptance_criteria: CI workflow runs pytest -m docs on the doc-tier label or label-routed selector
No remaining references to integration-marker fallback for these tests

cases: No integration-marker fallback referencing test_p7_3..6 in workflows (missing)

risks: CI yaml change requires PR-level CI run to fully validate — mitigation: review job logs after merge

Existing fast-tier selector `-m "not slow and not gpu and not e2e"` already includes docs tests; adding a separate `-m docs` job may double-run them — mitigation: prefer keeping fast tier coverage and only add a labelled job if dispatch matrix requires it

commands.command: uv run pytest -m "not slow and not gpu" --tb=line -q

completion_notes: Added `docs-tests` job to .github/workflows/ci.yml that runs `uv run pytest packages/mechdsl-core/tests/ -m docs --tb=short -q`. Triggered by workflow_dispatch, pull_request, or any PR carrying the `tier:docs` label.
Audit confirmed no workflow used `-m integration` to specifically target test_p7_3..6 (the integration-marker fallback was decorator-level only, in the test files, already cleared by P2-2).
Pre-existing fast-tier `test` job continues to cover docs-tier tests implicitly (`-m "not slow and not gpu and not e2e"`); the new dedicated job exists for explicit tier:docs label-routed dispatch.
PR-level CI run after merge will validate end-to-end (acknowledged risk in task JSON).
